messages:
tina_partners: Quick check-in: partners want the marketplace listing + certified-hardware badge to go live together. Proposed announce embargo 2026-06-03 08:00 PT. Who can own the SKU mapping and procurement flow docs?

rafael_marketplace: I can own SKU mapping and staging listing. Need final SKU ids from HW partner by 2026-05-25. Also need billing flow details (metered vs subscription) by 5/28.

priya_pm: I'll own the landing microcopy and the partner certification blurb. Please send any partner blurbs or compliance notes by 5/24. Localization scope: EN/DE/FR/ES/JP. Translations due 5/29.

dan_engineer: Engineering will deliver a certified-image artifact and a small validation script. ETA: image + validation script 2026-05-27. We'll also add a sample license-check curl snippet for marketplace install.

leah_sales: Sales asks: provide test buyer accounts and a checklist for AEs to validate procurement flow. Also need one-pager listing supported warranty/return terms for HW buyers.

devon_legal: Legal: need partner MSA excerpt for marketplace marketplace listing copy and logo/brand permissions. Please route partner-signed logo usage form to legal by 5/22. We'll try to turn around approvals by 5/26.

staging-bot: Reminder: staging marketplace preview slot reserved 2026-05-30 09:00 PT. Add listing assets to staging bucket by 5/29 EOD.

tina_partners: High-level launch checklist (condensed):
- Embargo: 2026-06-03 08:00 PT (owner: tina_partners)
- SKU mapping + billing model: owner rafael_marketplace (partner SKUs due 5/25, billing details due 5/28)
- Certified image + validation script: owner dan_engineer (ETA 5/27)
- Landing microcopy + cert blurb + localization: owner priya_pm (translations due 5/29)
- Partner logos & legal signoff: owner devon_legal (logo form due 5/22)
- AE enablement + test buyer accounts: owner leah_sales (test accounts by 5/31)
- Staging listing + assets in preview: owner rafael_marketplace + staging-bot (preview slot 5/30)
- Final freeze for PR/agency: 2026-06-01 EOD PT

priya_pm: Small content ask: what exact wording for the certification badge? Proposed: "Redwood-Certified for HW-Accel". Partners can propose edits. Also want a 1-line tech callout: "Optimized for low-latency inference on [Partner HW]."

dan_engineer: Draft validation snippet for docs: ```bash
# run validation after pulling certified image
./validate_certified_image.sh --image redwood-certified-hw:v1 --check-latency
# outputs PASS/FAIL and sample latency numbers
```
Drop the script in partner repo under /certification/.

rafael_marketplace: Procurement note: marketplace will show two purchase options: "Bring-your-own-license + HW" (metered API) and "Bundled appliance" (subscription). Need clear copy so buyers pick correct flow. We'll surface example invoices in staging.

leah_sales: Webinar idea: run a partner-led customer demo on 6/10 (two weeks after announce) focused on procurement and deployment. Can partners commit to co-demo? I'll start invites once test buyers are available.

devon_legal: Also flag: any partner quotes used in PR must include an approved testimonial clause in the partner form. Please get partners to check that box.

priya_pm: Localization owner notes: agency lead is looped. For JP we need partner approval on translated hero due 5/28. I'll post staging hero link 5/26.

staging-bot: Note: content freeze window begins 2026-06-01 00:00 PT. After freeze only critical fixes.

tina_partners: If anyone can't hit the dates above, call it out now. I'll compile a one-pager and share drive link once assets start landing. Keeping this thread as the canonical place for signoffs. :v:\"
